subject: math
question:
将 $f(x) = \begin{cases} x, & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 2 \\ 4 - x, & 2 < x \leqslant 4 \end{cases}$ 分别在以下情况展开为以8为周期的傅里叶级数.

(1) $f(x)$ 做奇延拓； (2) $f(x)$ 做偶延拓； (3) $f(x)$ 做零延拓.

steps.text: $f(x)$ 经题设条件下的3种延拓后均为连续函数，其傅里叶级数均处处收敛于 $f(x)$ .

(1) 做奇延拓:

$$
\begin{array}{l} {a _ {n} = 0 \quad (n = 0, 1, 2, \dots),} \\ {b _ {n} = \frac {2}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {4} f (x) \sin \frac {n \pi x}{4} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {2} x \sin \frac {n \pi x}{4} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {2} ^ {4} (4 - x) \sin \frac {n \pi x}{4} \mathrm{d} x \right],} \end{array}
$$

其中

$$
\int_ {2} ^ {4} (4 - x) \sin \frac {n \pi x}{4} d x \stackrel {4 - x = t} {=} \int_ {0} ^ {2} t \sin \frac {n \pi (4 - t)}{4} d t = (- 1) ^ {n - 1} \int_ {0} ^ {2} t \sin \frac {n \pi t}{4} d t,
$$

所以

$$
b _ {2 n} = 0 \quad (n = 1, 2, \dots).

\begin{array}{r l} b _ {2 n - 1} & = \int_ {0} ^ {2} t \sin \frac {(2 n - 1) \pi t}{4} \mathrm{d} t = \frac {- 4}{(2 n - 1) \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {2} t \mathrm{d} \cos \frac {(2 n - 1) \pi t}{4} \\ & = \frac {4}{(2 n - 1) \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {2} \cos \frac {(2 n - 1) \pi t}{4} \mathrm{d} t = (- 1) ^ {n - 1} \left(\frac {4}{(2 n - 1) \pi}\right) ^ {2} \quad (n = 1, 2, \dots). \end{array}
$$

因此

$$
f (x) = \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} (- 1) ^ {n - 1} \left(\frac {4}{(2 n - 1) \pi}\right) ^ {2} \sin \frac {(2 \dot {n} - 1) \pi x}{4} \quad (0 \leqslant x \leqslant 4).
$$

(2) 做偶延拓:

$$
b _ {n} = 0 \quad (n = 1, 2, \dots),

\begin{array}{l} a _ {0} = \frac {2}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {4} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {2} x \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {2} ^ {4} (4 - x) \mathrm{d} x \right] = 2, \\ a _ {n} = \frac {2}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {4} f (x) \cos \frac {n \pi x}{4} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {2} x \cos \frac {n \pi x}{4} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {2} ^ {4} (4 - x) \cos \frac {n \pi x}{4} \mathrm{d} x \right], \\ \Rightarrow a _ {2 n - 1} = 0, a _ {2 n} = [ (- 1) ^ {n} - 1 ] \left(\frac {2}{n \pi}\right) ^ {2} (n = 1, 2, \dots). \\ f (x) = 1 - 2 \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} \left(\frac {2}{(2 n - 1) \pi}\right) ^ {2} \cos \frac {(2 n - 1) \pi x}{2} (0 \leqslant x \leqslant 4). \end{array}
$$

(3) 做零延拓:

$$
f (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 0, & - 4 \leqslant x \leqslant 0, \\ x, & 0 <   x \leqslant 2, \\ 4 - x, & 2 <   x \leqslant 4. \end{array} \right.
$$

可按（1）和（2）中的方法直接展开，也可利用（1）和（2）的结果由如下方法写出展开式：记做奇延拓后的函数为 $f_{1}(x)$ ，做偶延拓后的函数为 $f_{2}(x)$ ，则做零延拓后的函数为

$$
\begin{array}{r l} f (x) & = \frac {1}{2} \left[ f _ {1} (x) + f _ {2} (x) \right] \\ & = \frac {1}{2} - 4 \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} \left(\frac {1}{(2 n - 1) \pi}\right) ^ {2} \left(\cos \frac {(2 n - 1) \pi x}{2} + (- 1) ^ {n} 2 \sin \frac {(2 n - 1) \pi x}{4}\right) \quad (0 \leqslant x \leqslant 4). \end{array}
$$

cdps.prompt: 如何选取周期/奇偶延拓并计算傅里叶系数？
cdps.expected: 确定周期与奇偶性，按公式求 a_n、b_n 或写出展开。

cdps.prompt: 傅里叶级数或相关结论是什么？
